Redemption Value
CashBack is in Reward Points and is redeemable against the statement balance upon request.
1 Rewards points is equivalent:
1. CashBack (as against statement balance) = ₹1
2. On SmartBuy - Flight and Hotel bookings = ₹0.30

4. Rewards catalogue = upto 0.30

What is the Millennia Credit Card?
The Millennia Credit Card is an HDFC Bank credit card that offers a range of benefits and rewards on your everyday spending. It provides CashBack on online and offline purchases, lounge access privileges, fuel surcharge waivers, and much more. Apply for the Millennia Credit Card to enjoy a world of exclusive benefits and rewards.
What is the minimum credit score required for the Millennia Credit Card?
The minimum credit score required for the Millennia Credit Card is subject to HDFC Bank's internal policies. We recommend you check your eligibility to determine if you meet the requirements.
Is the Millennia Credit Card free?
The Millennia Credit Card comes with an annual membership fee of ₹1000 plus applicable taxes. However, you can get the renewal fee waived by spending ₹1,00,000 and above within the first year.

I already have an existing XTRAREWARDS Program Customer ID. Can I still apply for an IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card?
Yes. You can still apply for an IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card. In this case, instead of creating a new XR CID, your existing XR CID will be merged with this program and you can start converting Fuel Points into XRP and use XRP to redeem free fuel at participating IndianOil Fuel Outlets.
NOTE:
Make sure that your Mobile Number registered with the Bank is the same as the mobile number registered with IndianOil XTRAREWARDSTM Program
In case the registered Mobile Number with the Bank is different from the one registered with IndianOil XTRAREWARDSTM Program, or for any questions or help, you can seek assistance through:
Call us on 1800 1600 / 1800 2600 (accessible across India) Customer travelling overseas can reach us on 022-61606160
Connect with Eva  for quick solutions to common queries
Contact Nearest Branch
Please visit  HDFC Bank Contact Us  page for more details.
I bought items from Amazon which along included vegetable oil as well. Why didn’t I get 5% FP on this transaction?
Eligibility for Fuel Points on transaction is basis the Merchant Category Code (MCC) captured for the transaction. Only those MCCs recognized and considered by Partner Networks (Visa/RuPay) for the above mentioned categories will accrue 5% Fuel Points (FP). If your transaction didn’t accrue any FP, it is because it is not recognized as Fuel/Groceries/Utilities/Bill Payment as per standard Merchant Category Code
Should I register for XTRAREWARDSTM Program? If so, how to I enroll myself for it?
IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Cardholders are automatically and mandatorily registered with IndianOil XTRAREWARDSTM Program during the time of Credit Card issuance.
Once the Customer is automatically registered, you will receive an SMS on your registered mobile number from IndianOil, with the confirmation of your XTRAREWARDSTM Program account successfully been created along with an XTRAREWARDSTM Customer ID (XR CID).
In case you haven’t received the confirmation SMS within 5 business days of receiving your Credit Card, please connect with the Bank for resolution.
Post creation of your XR CID, you could also install “IndianOil ONE” App from Android Play Store or IOS App store (Not mandatory) to help keep track of your XRP Balance and Transactions
Note: XR CID is created by Indian Oil for the purpose of redeeming points against free fuel. This is different from the Customer ID maintained with the Bank.
Can I make partial payments using XTRAREWARD POINTSTM?
Yes, Post verifying that the IndianOil Retail outlet is a  Participating Outlet,  check with the Merchant on Payment option using XTRAREWARDTM POINT. Redemption process flow is mentioned in Q2. If you are unable to pay your fuel bill entirely through XTRAREWARDTM POINTS (XRP), Then you can partially pay through XRP and partially through your IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card.
What If I wish to cancel my membership with IndianOil XTRAREWARDS Program?
Having Customer ID with XTRAREWARDS Program is necessary since  without this membership, you cannot convert Fuel Points accrued on your credit card into XTRAREWARDTM POINTS and use them at IndianOil Fuel Outlets for free fuel redemption.  Also, having this XR CID is critical to receive information or any status update on your XTRAREWARDSTM Program account with IndianOil.
Can I get Fuel Point on all spends?
Fuel Points can be accrued on all kinds of Retail Spends that include both Online and Point of Sale (PoS) transactions. However, there are few kinds of transactions for which you will not get Fuel Points. They are:
Fuel transactions at other petrol pumps
Any kind of wallet-loading
On Returned purchases, disputed or unauthorized/fraudulent transactions
EMI Transactions
Account Fees and Payment
Purchase of jewellery/gold coins or its equivalents
I have spent more than Rs. 5000 on Petrol/Diesel/CNG in a calendar month. However, why I received only 150 FP. Why?
Please Note that there is a monthly capping on Fuel Points accrued on the below mentioned spends.
Spends at IndianOil Outlets –
- Monthly Max cap for the first 6 months from card issuance: 250 FP
- Monthly Max cap post 6 months: 150 FP
Spends on Groceries – Monthly Max cap: 100 FP
Spends on Utilities and Bill Payments – Monthly Max cap: 100 FP
What are the benefits of a Fuel Credit Card?
Fuel Credit Cards, like the Indian Oil Credit Card, offer fuel surcharge waivers, reward points on fuel spends, and free fuel accumulation for savings on fuel and utility bills.
What is the Cashback of the IndianOil Credit Card? What is the CashBack offered by the IndianOil Credit Card?
Indian Oil Credit Card provides CashBack in the form of reward points, redeemable for free fuel or other options. Details are in the card's terms.
How do I check my balance Fuel Points?
Fuel Points accrued on all eligible transactions posted within the calendar month will be added up and credited on the 1st of the next calendar month. Please note that maximum capping will be applied before crediting them.
A. You can check the Fuel Points accrued for the previous calendar month’s transactions posted on the current month statement shared with you (Physical or E-statement)
B. You can also check by Logging into:
NetBanking -> Cards Tab -> Click on “Enquiry” -> Reward Points Redemption -> Choose your IndianOil HDFC Bank Credit Card Number -> View total Fuel Points accrued
Can I Use the IndianOil Credit Card for Shopping?
Yes, you can use it for shopping, offering benefits not only on fuel but also rewards or cashback on other transactions.

*The Most Important Terms and Conditions for each of our banking offerings features all the specific terms and conditions that govern their use. You must go through it thoroughly to fully understand the terms and conditions applicable to any banking product you choose.
Can a customer get the voucher if he is classified as delinquent?
Customers classified as delinquents (as per Bank policy) during the promotion or 30 days post the promotion will not be eligible for this program.
How can reward points be redeemed?
Redeem points against the Reward Catalogue (1 RP = Up to ₹0.25) or as statement cashback (1 RP = Up to ₹0.20). Redemption is based on your request and meeting minimum RP balance conditions.
Can a customer qualify for the offer multiple times in a Quarter?
A customer will be eligible only once in a quarter at any given point in time. Even if a customer achieves higher spending during the period, the customer will receive the Rs ₹500 e-voucher only once.
What happens if a MoneyBack Cardholder is getting Upgraded / Downgraded during the Quarter?
In case an existing MoneyBack credit card gets upgraded or downgraded during the program quarter to any other card variant, the customer will qualify for the quarterly spend benefit of the MoneyBack credit card only if the Quarterly spend target is achieved before the date of upgrade/downgrade. Spends calculation for Quarterly spending benefits on the new MoneyBack Credit Card variant will start from the date of upgrade/downgrade.
What are the benefits of the HDFC Bank MoneyBack Credit Card?
The HDFC Bank MoneyBack Credit Card is a CashBack Credit Card designed to cater to your convenience, offering rewards on every transaction. Earn 2 reward points for every ₹150 spent, 2X rewards for online transactions (equivalent to 4 RP per Rs ₹150 spent online), and the opportunity to earn up to Rs ₹2,000 in gift vouchers annually by spending ₹50,000 in a calendar quarter. Additionally, you can redeem your reward points as cashback against your card statement at the rate of 100 RP = ₹20.
What are the e-vouchers that will be offered?
As per the current program, a customer can choose (any one per quarter) from e-vouchers of Pizza Hut, Book My Show, Big Bazaar, Bata, Levis, Woodland, Mainland China, and Myntra. The list of merchants can change without prior notice at the Bank’s discretion.
How is the Quarter defined?
A quarter is defined as a calendar quarter, e.g., Q1 = April 1, 2018 - June 30, 2018.
How are reward points posted to your card account?
Reward points are systematically posted for every transaction made using this CashBack card. Track them on your statement or through HDFC Bank’s NetBanking. The 2X benefit for online spending in the current cycle is credited at the start of the next cycle.
For example:
Consider the following scenario involving Customer A, whose billing cycle ends on the 15th of each month. Let’s say he made online purchases worth Rs ₹60,00 during the Jan to Feb’20 billing period. Here's a breakdown of the earned reward points:
For Jan to Feb’20, he earned 80 points at a rate of 2 points for every ₹150 spent.
Moving to the next billing cycle, Feb to Mar’20, an additional 80 points are added to his account (thanks to a 1X supplementary points boost)
Customer A secures 160 points, demonstrating an effective reward rate of 4 points for every ₹150 spent. This showcases the positive outcome of his ₹6,000 online expenditures.
What spends qualify for the offer?
The spend milestone program is valid for retail transactions only. Cash transactions, Dial-An-EMI, Cash-on-Call, Balance Transfer, Personal Loan on Credit Card, etc., are not eligible. Transactions that are reversed or cancelled will not be considered. Returned purchases, disputed or unauthorised/fraudulent transactions, and Card Account Fees will not be considered for this offer.
How will customers get to know if they have qualified under the Offer?
The bank will communicate offer eligibility to the eligible MoneyBack customers within the next calendar quarter. The communication will be completed within 90 days from the end of the quarter. For example, eligible customers for the July-Sep quarter will begin to get their eligibility notifications by December 31st. The eligibility will be communicated to customers on their Mobile No & email ID registered with the Bank via SMS & email.
For how many days is a customer eligible for the offer after receiving eligibility Email and SMS?
The customer must claim the voucher (i.e., respond with the selected merchant name) within 60 days from the eligibility SMS/Mailer date.
What is the MoneyBack 2X feature?
The MoneyBack 2X feature ensures you receive 100% more reward points for online spending with the MoneyBack card. Offline transactions earn 2 Reward Points (RP) per ₹150, while online/e-commerce transactions yield 4 Reward Points (RP) per ₹150.
Can a customer opt for cash instead of an E-voucher?
This offer is non-cashable, not extendable, and non-negotiable.
When will the E-voucher be dispatched to the customer?
Customers need to claim the voucher by visiting the link in the Eligibility Mailer or by sending an SMS according to the short codes in the eligibility SMS. E-vouchers will be triggered immediately to the customers on receipt of the voucher choice.
What is the Spend Milestone Offer?
To qualify for the Spend Milestone Offer, spend ₹50,000 a quarter and receive a ₹500 e-voucher. The offer commenced on April 1, 2018.
Is there any capping for reward points earned on the MoneyBack 2X Feature?
Yes, there's a maximum limit of 15,000 reward points per cycle. The additional 2 RP per Rs ₹150 from the 2X feature is capped at 500 points monthly.
For example:
Let's say a customer spent ₹40,000 within a statement cycle. Based on their spending, they would earn reward points as follows:
Reward points earned during the transaction cycle = (40000 / 150) * 2, which equals 534 RP
Additional reward points (1X as per 2X product feature) earned in the next statement cycle = Lesser of 500 or (40000 / 150) * 2, which equals 500 RP
Therefore, the customer would earn 1034 Reward Points for this transaction (534 + 500).
Will customers get a reminder of eligibility mailer & SMS?
Customers who have not claimed the e-voucher will be sent an eligibility Reminder on the 30th and 45th Day.
How long is a voucher valid?
An e-voucher will be valid for 90 days from the date of issue.
How to apply for a MoneyBack Credit Card?
We are currently not accepting new applications for the HDFC MoneyBack Credit Card. However, you can explore a range of other credit cards that may suit your needs. Click here to view our available options and find the right card for you.
If a customer holds multiple cards, can they club spend for offer eligibility?
If a customer has more than 1 (one) HDFC Bank Credit Card, spending on the cards cannot be clubbed by the customer to qualify for the said offer.

What is an IRCTC Credit Card?
The IRCTC Credit Card, specifically the HDFC Bank IRCTC Credit Card, is a specialised Credit Card designed in collaboration with the Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation (IRCTC). This card offers a range of benefits, including reward points, CashBack, travel perks, IRCTC executive lounge access, and more making it an ideal choice for frequent train travellers.

What is the are the travel offer benefits offered by IRCTC on the IRCTC Credit Card?
The IRCTC Credit Card offers several travel benefits:
5 Reward Points for every ₹100 spent on the IRCTC ticketing website and the Rail Connect app.
Additional 5% cashback on train ticket bookings via HDFC Bank SmartBuy.
8 complimentary access passes to select IRCTC executive lounges every year.
1% transaction charges waiver on transactions done on the IRCTC ticketing website and Rail Connect app.
Can I withdraw money from the IRCTC Credit Card?
Yes, you can withdraw cash using your IRCTC Credit Card, However, the bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of ₹500 whichever is higher. The bank also offers a cash advance limit of 40%. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit.
Can I use the IRCTC Credit Card for international transactions?
While the IRCTC Credit Card is primarily designed for domestic use, it may be accepted for international transactions. However, it's crucial to check with the issuing bank to confirm the card's international validity. Keep in mind that international transactions may attract additional charges, including currency conversion fees.
What is the use of IRCTC Credit Card?
The IRCTC Credit Card offers various benefits like reward points, cashback, lounge access, and transaction charge waivers. It can be used for making purchases on the IRCTC website and the Rail Connect app, earning reward points on every transaction. Additionally, the card offers cashback on various other expenses, fuel surcharge waivers, and access to exclusive lounges.
How to apply for the IRCTC Credit Card?
To apply for the IRCTC Credit Card, follow these general steps:
Visit the official website of the HDFC Bank.
Navigate to the credit card section and find the IRCTC Credit Card.
Fill out the online application form with the required personal and financial details and documents.
Submit the application and await approval from the bank.
Once approved, the bank will dispatch the credit card to your registered address.
What are the key features of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
5 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on IRCTC Ticketing Website/ Rail Connect App
1 Reward Point per ₹100 spent on all other merchant (Spends on EMI interest amount and repayment, Fuel, Wallet load, gift vouchers, prepaid card loading, cash advances, payment of outstanding balances, payment of card fee and other charges, Government charges, Education, rental transactions etc. are excluded).
Additional 5% CashBack on Train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy.
Value of 1 RP= ₹1 for Train ticket booking
Gift Voucher Worth ₹500 on first transaction within 37 days of card issuance.
Gift Voucher worth ₹500 on quarterly spends of ₹30,000.
Reversal of 1% Transaction charges on transactions done on IRCTC Ticketing Website and Rail Connect
8 Complimentary access to select IRCTC Executive Lounges every year (Max 2 per quarter)
What are the Fees and Charges applicable on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
First Year Joining Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes
Renewal Membership Fee – ₹500/- + Applicable Taxes
Can my Joining fee or Card renewal fee be waived off?
Renewal fee can be waived off if a customer spends ₹1,50,000 or more in an anniversary year, before your Credit Card renewal date.
What are the other benefits on of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
1% Fuel Surcharge waiver on fuel transactions (Minimum transaction of ₹400, Maximum transaction of ₹5,000 & Maximum CashBack of ₹250 per statement cycle)
(Fuel surcharge varies from 1% to 2.5% of fuel transaction base amount. The rate of surcharge may vary depending on the fuel station and their acquiring bank. GST is as applicable and is not reversible.)
How can I apply for IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
You can apply for this Credit Card through both online and offline modes. To apply online, you can visit the official website of HDFC Bank - http://www.hdfcbank.com or you can visit the official website of IRCTC – https://irctc.co.in
To apply offline, you may visit the nearest branch of the bank to fill out the application form.
How can I get my Welcome gift voucher?
Customer will be eligible for a gift voucher worth Rs.₹500 on performing 1 transaction of any amount within the first 37 days from card issuance date.
Activation vouchers will be issued to customers within 90 working days after the end of card issuance month.
Bank will share the voucher code to customer via SMS/Email.
Customers need to claim the voucher by visiting the link given in the Eligibility Mailer, or by sending an SMS according to the short codes given in the eligibility SMS. E-Vouchers will be triggered immediately to the customers on receipt of the-voucher choice.
Post verification of voucher code the redeemed amount will be credited to cardholders e-wallet balance
Customer can also book the ticket by using wallet balance.
How many reward points will be earned if a cardholder spends through HDFC Bank SmartBuy?
A cardholder will be eligible for an additional 5% CashBack + 5% as HDFC Bank Reward points as per product feature if he/she does a transaction through HDFC Bank SmartBuy on IRCTC. All other existing SmartBuy offers will be applicable as per SmartBuy Terms & Conditions.
What is the loyalty number printed on the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
The loyalty number printed on the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card plastic is a an 11-digit number which gets allocated on approval of the card application. Cardholder shall avail the benefits of the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card by linking the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number to his/her existing IRCTC login id.
How to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login?
You can link your 11 digits loyalty number post joining fee payment of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card. You need to use the same email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card.
Steps for linking the loyalty number with IRCTC login id are mentioned below:
Visit IRCTC Ticketing Website/Rail Connect App and access the IRCTC account with your existing login id (Username and password). In case you do not have an existing login id on IRCTC Ticketing Website then you would need to register yourself by signing up at IRCTC.
Select the option- “Add Loyalty Account “link provided under Loyalty Account Tab.
Enter the 11 digits Loyalty Number printed at the back of your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card, then click on sent OTP.
Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and click on Confirm.
After entering the OTP, cardholder will receive confirmation message of successful linking of Loyalty Account.
You can check your Loyalty Account details under the “Loyalty Account tab”.
You will not be able to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card if there is a mismatch in the email id, mobile no. and date of birth that was mentioned while applying for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit card.
You can call on IRCTC customer care on 14646 or 0755-6610661/0755-4090600 if you are unable to link your IRCTC HDFC Bank Card loyalty number with your IRCTC login ID and password.
Can I withdraw cash through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
Yes, you can withdraw cash via this Credit Card through any ATM. However, the Bank will charge a cash advance fee of 2.5% of the transaction amount or a minimum of RS. ₹500 whichever is higher. At HDFC Bank, we offer a cash advance limit of 40 %. So, if your Credit Card limit is Rs ₹1 lakh, you can withdraw cash up to Rs ₹40,000. The type of your Credit Card ascertains your cash advance limit.
What should I do if my card is lost or damaged?
If your Credit Card is lost or stolen, you should immediately inform the Bank by visiting the nearest branch or by calling on the customer care number. Alternatively, login to HDFC Bank Online at once and report your lost or stolen card in the service requests section in the menu.
How can I check the status of my credit card application?
You can check the status of your Credit Card application by visiting the official website of the Bank. On the homepage, under the cards section, you will find an option of to ‘Track your Application’. You will be asked for an Application Reference Number (ARN), post which the Bank will be able to tell you the status of your Credit Card application.

What are the Reward Points?
"Reward Points” shall mean the points earned by the Rewards Program members, for undertaking such transactions and activities as specified under the Rewards Program, which may be redeemed towards purchase of railway tickets and/ or other services on the Platform and/ or through any other redemption options/ on other platforms mutually agreed upon by the Parties.
What is the validity for reward points?
Reward points are valid for 2 years
When will the earned Reward Points be posted in the cardholder statement?
The total Reward points earned in a cycle will reflect in the subsequent month statement of the cardholder
How can I check my reward point balance?
Steps to check your Reward Points balance through NetBanking
You can check your reward point balance in your NetBanking account.
You need to login to your HDFC Bank NetBanking account
Then go to Cards and click on Request
Select your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card number
Now select “Rewards” and you will be able to see your rewards balance.
Steps to check your Reward Points balance through SmartBuy
Login to your HDFC Bank SmartBuy account. Click on the “Unlock Reward Summary” tab would appear on the top right corner of your screen.
You would need to input your mobile number registered with HDFC Bank, Last four digit of your Credit Card and your date of birth.
You would be able to see your reward point balance once the details provided by you is are verified.
How do I redeem these Points?
You can use your HDFC Bank Reward Points for train ticket booking via SmartBuy
Steps to redeem Reward Points from HDFC Bank SmartBuy:
To redeem the Reward points, the customer needs to visit HDFC Bank SmartBuy Platform. https://offers.smartbuy.hdfcbank.com/v1/foryou
Inside HDFC Bank SmartBuy platform, the customer can select IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card under Privileges.
Either a customer can login after entering landing to the IRCTC HDFC Bank Card or customer can login later once prompted while trying to book the train ticket.
To book the train ticket enter source station, destination, date of journey and submit the information
Check the class of travel, click on the preferred train and check the seat availability for the proposed date(s).
Enter your IRCTC Authorised Partner user ID or create an IRCTC Authorised Partner account if you don’t have one already.
Submit the traveller’s details.
Pay with Points + Pay or Pay option from IRCTC Co Brand Card.
At payment gateway, the customer can see option to pay with Points + Pay with Credit Card or Pay with Credit Card.
On the next payment page, the customer can see the Reward Point Slider that they can use to add the number of reward points for redemption
Redemption can be made only against a maximum of 70% of fare ticket amount on train ticket booking via HDFC Bank SmartBuy, inclusive of fares of all the passengers and service charges levied by IRCTC.
Is there any Reward Redemption charge?
Yes. On successful points redemption HDFC Bank Credit Card will be charged Rs.₹99 + GST on the Credit Card. But this could change subject to HDFC Bank’s terms and conditions. Please read our terms and conditions regularly for any changes, if applicable.
Do I need minimum points to redeem?
Yes, you would need a minimum of 100 points to redeem.
Is there any limit to redeem points?
Yes, you can redeem up to a maximum of 70% of booking value through Reward Points. Rest will have to be paid via Credit Card.
What if I don’t have enough Points to redeem?
You can choose to pay partially using the reward points and the balance payment through your IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card.
Please remember that you would need a minimum 100 points to redeem.
But, if you do not have enough reward points to redeem you can continue to pay full amount through IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card.
Is IRCTC Executive lounge access available on IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card?
Customer can enjoy 8 Complimentary IRCTC Executive Lounge access per year (2 per quarter)
₹ 2/- will be charged from the customer’s account to validate the card for complimentary lounge access. This amount will be non-refundable.
What facilities do I get in the IRCTC Executive Lounge?
The complimentary access to IRCTC Executive Lounge will include the below facilities:
Two Hours of lounge stay
A/C comfortable sitting arrangements
Access to washrooms / changing room
1 Buffet meal- Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner as per the time of visit.
Unlimited tea & coffee
Free Wi-Fi
Charging points
Newspaper and Magazine
Any additional service such as recliners or more shall be chargeable separate as per the operator price for that service.
How does a cardholder calculate Reward points earned on monthly spends?
Reward Points are calculated on the spends made within the calendar month cycle. Only settled transactions within the calendar month will be considered for Reward Points posting.
For example: Cardholder statement is received on every 18th of the month. The Reward Points accrued for cardholder transactions from 1st of January till 31st of January will be calculated and posted on the 1st of February and the same can be seen when cardholder the receives the statement on 18th of February.
How can I check my eligibility for this card?

Features of a Commercial Credit Card
HDFC Bank’s Commercial Credit Card offers a range of benefits, including up to 50 days of interest-free credit period, savings on business spends annually, and accelerated reward points on various business-related transactions. We also provide exclusive vouchers, complimentary lounge access, and a specially curated business insurance package tailored to your business needs.
Benefits of Commercial Credit Cards
Commercial Credit Cards offer a wide range of benefits:
Simplified and Streamlined Expense Management: Commercial Credit Cards simplify expense tracking by providing detailed statements that categorise spending. This makes it easier for companies to monitor and manage their finances.
Credit Limit Flexibility: Commercial Credit Cards may often come with higher credit limits than personal cards, providing businesses with greater purchasing power to cover various expenses.
Employee Spending Control: Commercial Cards may offer features like individual spending limits and real-time monitoring which allows businesses to control and track employee spending effectively.
Credit Card Rewards: Certain specific Commercial Credit Cards may also offer rewards programmes on business spendings, such as cashback or reward points for business-related purchases.
Travel Benefits: These cards may offer travel-related perks, including travel insurance, airport lounge access and reward points redemption against flights and accommodation. This can be beneficial for companies with frequent travel needs.
Streamlined Vendor Payments: Purchase Cards can be used to manage vendor payments, utility bills, fuel payments, bulk payments, etc.
How to Apply for a Commercial Credit Card?
To apply for HDFC Bank’s Commercial Credit Cards , you need to be self-employed individuals, proprietors of micro and small businesses, medium enterprises, traders, merchants, and professionals such as doctors, lawyers, chartered accountants, and consultants. If you fit these eligibility criteria, you can visit the HDFC Bank website, where you can choose your preferred Commerical Credit Card, fill out an application form, submit your KYC documents, and apply online.
How Do Commercial Credit Cards Work?
Here’s a brief on how Commercial Credit Cards work:
Issuance: Depending on the company’s eligibility, the card issuer will issue a Commercial Credit Card for the corporates. The company can then request the card issuer to issue cards to individual employees in their name.
Card Limits: Transaction limits can be set on the card to ensure the employees do not go overboard with spending. Depending on the employee’s designation in the company, the card limits can vary.
Usage: Commercial Credit Cards can be of two types, Corporate Credit Cards and Purchase Credit Cards. The former allows employees to pay for business expenses like travelling, meals, commuting, etc. A Purchase Credit Card allows companies to manage vendor payments.
Settlement: The Commercial Credit Card bills are directly settled by the company. The company may make a consolidated payment for all cardholders.
How to use a Commercial Credit Card?
You can use and manage your HDFC Bank Commercial Credit Card through the Commercial Card Portal. This portal allows you to make credit limit adjustments, report lost or stolen cards, and generate PINs.

How does a cardholder calculate cashpoints earned on monthly spends?

Can a UPI RuPay Credit Card be used for UPI?
Yes, RuPay Credit Cards can be seamlessly used for UPI transactions. Users can download and register on their preferred UPI app, such as PayZapp, GPay, PhonePe, Mobikwik, PayTM, BHIM, or Slice. By registering the UPI RuPay Credit Card using the Credit Card PIN, users can make UPI payments and leverage the associated benefits, combining the strengths of Credit Cards on UPI platforms. Additionally, this card allows cash withdrawals at ATMs, providing users with a comprehensive financial tool for various transactions.
How to set up a PIN for HDFC Bank UPI RuPay Credit Card?
Cardholder can set up a PIN for UPI RuPay Credit Card by calling IVR Toll number 1860 266 0333
Steps for IVR:
Call IVR Toll number 1860 266 0333 from your registered mobile number:
Enter the last 4 digits of the Cardholder credit card followed by hash (#)
Dial 1 to generate a Credit card PIN
Again Dial 1 when prompted to "Generate a One Time Password" (OTP) to Cardholder mobile as an SMS and enter the 6-digit OTP
On successful entry of OTP, the IVR will confirm successful validation and ask the cardholder to set the 4-digit PIN followed by the hash(#) key. If cardholder get disconnected at step# 4:- Redial the Toll number, after Step2 ….“Dial 2 to enter the 6 digit OTP

Once registered, users can make UPI payments using their Credit Cards, experiencing the dual advantage of both Credit Card benefits and UPI transactions.
What is RuPay UPI Credit Card?
RuPay UPI Credit Card combines the benefits of RuPay and UPI, offering a seamless fusion of credit card and UPI functionalities. This RuPay Credit Card for UPI serves as a versatile financial tool, allowing users to make secure transactions both as a Credit Card and through UPI platforms.

How will a cardholder get cashback on EMI spends?
No. EMI spends shall not earn any CashPoints
What documents are required for a UPI RuPay Credit Card?
No document proof is required for applying UPI RuPay Credit card.
Cardholder did a transaction in the groceries, and supermarket category and didn’t get CashPoints as per the 3% cashback feature?
CashPoints of 3% will be calculated basis the Merchant Category Code (MCC) shared by the RuPay network. If in case the MCC is not available in the set-up, such transactions will not qualify for the benefit. Only Below mentioned MCCs will be considered for cashpoints posting Merchant category & MCC code: Grocery & supermarket 5411, Dining 5812, 5814
What are cashpoints?
CashPoints are an exclusive rewards metric system created by HDFC Bank for credit cardholders which can be used towards cashback redemption against the statement at the rate of 1 CashPoint = ₹0.25 for UPI RuPay Credit Card Holders.
Please note that CashPoints will be posted as reward points only.
Cardholder did a transaction in the utility category and didn’t get CashPoints as per the 2% cashback feature?
CashPoints of 2% will be calculated basis the Merchant Category Code (MCC) shared by the RuPay network. If in case the MCC is not available in the set-up, such transactions will not qualify for the benefit. Only 4900 Merchant Category code (MCC) as defined by RuPay Card Network is considered under utility spends
What are the key features of the UPI RuPay Credit Card?
3% CashPoints on groceries, supermarket, dining & all PayZapp transactions
2% CashPoints on utility spends
1% CashPoints on other spends
Except for fuel, rent payments, EMI spends, Govt related transactions and wallet/ gift /prepaid card loads & voucher purchase transactions.
Can the cardholder use UPI RuPay Credit Card for normal credit card Ecom transactions?
Yes, cardholders can use this card for normal Ecom purchases as well as UPI purchases.
Will the cardholder get cashpoints for UPI Purchases done Via UPI RuPay Credit Card?
Yes, Cardholder will earn cashpoints for both UPI spends as well normal credit card Ecom spends ( As per the maximum cashpoints capping mentioned in Question 1)
Can the cardholder opt for Physical HDFC Bank UPI RuPay Credit Card?
No, UPI RuPay Credit Card will be issued only as virtual card and no physical card will be issued.
What are the Fees and Charges applicable on the UPI RuPay Credit Card?
First Year Membership Fee of ₹99 + applicable taxes and renewal membership Fee of ₹99 + applicable taxes
Spend ₹25,000 in 12 months (Annual year) and get the renewal fee waived for the next renewal year.
Goods and Services Tax (GST)
Effective 1st July 2017, Goods & Services Tax (GST) is applicable on all fees, charges and interest transactions.
The applicable GST would be dependent on place of provision (POP) and place of supply (POS). If POP and POS are in the same state then applicable GST would be CGST and SGST/UTGST else, IGST.
GST for fee & charges / Interest transactions Billed on statement date will be reflected in next month's statement.
GST levied will not be reversed on any dispute on fee & charges/interest.
How can a cardholder use the CashBack earned?
CashBack is a CashPoints that can be redeemed against the statement balance at a rate of 1 CashPoint = ₹0.25, via net banking or offline redemption on flights, hotel bookings, and rewards catalogue at the SmartBuy rewards portal.
A minimum of 500 cashpoints is required for redemption.
Maximum of 50% of the booking value can be redeemed through CashPoints.
CashPoints are valid for 2 years from the date of accumulation.
What is the minimum transaction amount that is eligible for cashpoints under 3%, 2% & 1% features?
Minimum transaction amounts of ₹100 & above only are eligible for cashpoints posting for 3%, 2% and 1% features
Which UPI app allows Credit Card?
RuPay UPI Credit Card functionality is compatible with various UPI apps, offering users flexibility in choosing their preferred platform. Users can seamlessly link and use their RuPay Credit Card on popular UPI apps like PayZapp, GPay, PhonePe, Mobikwik, PayTM, BHIM, and Slice, enhancing accessibility and convenience.
When will the earned CashPoints be posted in the cardholder statement?
The total CashPoints earned in a cycle will be reflected in the subsequent statement of the cardholder.
How to use UPI RuPay Credit Card?
UPI RuPay Credit Card integrates Credit Card benefits with UPI transactions. Here's a step-by-step guide:
Download the UPI app such as PayZapp or PhonePe from the app store.
Link your UPI Rupay Credit Card to the UPI app and set your UPI PIN for transaction verification
Enjoy secure transactions and withdraw cash at the ATMs using UPI RuPay Credit Card.
Where can the cardholder view the UPI RuPay Credit card details?
Cardholder can view the UPI RuPay credit card in MyCards platform by logging in through a registered mobile number and can view the card details like 16-digit Credit Card number, CVV & Date of Expiry.
Note: The UPI RuPay Credit Card will be available in MyCards platform after the application is processed.
How many CashPoints will be earned if a cardholder spends through SmartBuy?
Spends done through SmartBuy shall not be eligible for CashPoints

How can I apply for the PIXEL Play Credit Card?
You can apply for the card directly by clicking here . You can also apply through PayZapp and receive instant approval.
What CashBack benefits does the PIXEL Play Credit Card offer?
PIXEL Play Credit Card offers 5% Cashback on selected brand, and 3% Cashback on choice of Ecommerce Platform. Customers are also eligible for 1% CashBack on all transactions, 5% on SmartBuy purchases, and 1% on UPI spends (for the RuPay variant).
Can I convert purchases into EMIs?
Yes, you can instantly convert transactions into EMIs via PayZapp, choosing from flexible tenure options.
Which modes of contactless payments are available for PIXEL Play customers ?
Customers can Tap & Pay at POS (Point of Sale), Swipe to Pay for online and UPI transactions, or Scan & Pay via UPI (for the RuPay variant). PIXEL Visa cardholders can also use Mobile Tap & Pay on NFC-enabled Android smartphones.​
How is interest calculated on unpaid balances?
Interest on unpaid balances for the HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card is calculated based on the Annual Percentage Rate (APR). If the full amount is not paid by the due date, interest is charged on the outstanding balance from the transaction date until the payment is made.
What are the reissue charges for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card?
The reissue fee for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card are as 199 + gst. This fee applies when a card is reissued due to loss, theft, or damage. The charge is billed to the cardholder in the next statement.
What is the fee for IRCTC transactions for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Cards?
The fee for IRCTC transactions using the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card is 1% of the transaction amount plus GST. This fee applies to all railway ticket purchases made through IRCTC, except for the IRCTC HDFC Bank Credit Card.
What is a cash advance fee for HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card?
The cash advance fee for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card is 2.5% of the amount withdrawn or ₹500, whichever is higher. This fee is billed to the cardholder in the next statement. Additionally, finance charges apply from the withdrawal date until full payment is made.
What is the interest-free grace period for the HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card?
The HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card offers a grace period of 20 to 50 days from the date of purchase. This period is subject to the merchant submitting the charge and is not applicable if the previous month's balance has not been cleared in full.
What are the foreign transaction charges?
The HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card charges a 3.5% foreign transaction fee on all international purchases. This fee covers the cost of currency conversion and processing international transactions.
Is there a fuel surcharge on HDFC Bank Pixel Play Credit Card?
The HDFC Bank Pixel Credit Card offers a 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between ₹400 and ₹5,000 at all fuel stations across India. The maximum waiver is ₹250 per statement cycle.

Features of a Commercial Credit Card
HDFC Bank’s Commercial Credit Card offers a range of benefits, including up to 50 days of interest-free credit period, savings on business spends annually, and accelerated reward points on various business-related transactions. We also provide exclusive vouchers, complimentary lounge access, and a specially curated business insurance package tailored to your business needs.
Benefits of Commercial Credit Cards
Commercial Credit Cards offer a wide range of benefits:
Simplified and Streamlined Expense Management: Commercial Credit Cards simplify expense tracking by providing detailed statements that categorise spending. This makes it easier for companies to monitor and manage their finances.
Credit Limit Flexibility: Commercial Credit Cards may often come with higher credit limits than personal cards, providing businesses with greater purchasing power to cover various expenses.
Employee Spending Control: Commercial Cards may offer features like individual spending limits and real-time monitoring which allows businesses to control and track employee spending effectively.
Credit Card Rewards: Certain specific Commercial Credit Cards may also offer rewards programmes on business spendings, such as cashback or reward points for business-related purchases.
Travel Benefits: These cards may offer travel-related perks, including travel insurance, airport lounge access and reward points redemption against flights and accommodation. This can be beneficial for companies with frequent travel needs.
Streamlined Vendor Payments: Purchase Cards can be used to manage vendor payments, utility bills, fuel payments, bulk payments, etc.
How to Apply for a Commercial Credit Card?
To apply for HDFC Bank’s Commercial Credit Cards , you need to be self-employed individuals, proprietors of micro and small businesses, medium enterprises, traders, merchants, and professionals such as doctors, lawyers, chartered accountants, and consultants. If you fit these eligibility criteria, you can visit the HDFC Bank website, where you can choose your preferred Commerical Credit Card, fill out an application form, submit your KYC documents, and apply online.
How Do Commercial Credit Cards Work?
Here’s a brief on how Commercial Credit Cards work:
Issuance: Depending on the company’s eligibility, the card issuer will issue a Commercial Credit Card for the corporates. The company can then request the card issuer to issue cards to individual employees in their name.
Card Limits: Transaction limits can be set on the card to ensure the employees do not go overboard with spending. Depending on the employee’s designation in the company, the card limits can vary.
Usage: Commercial Credit Cards can be of two types, Corporate Credit Cards and Purchase Credit Cards. The former allows employees to pay for business expenses like travelling, meals, commuting, etc. A Purchase Credit Card allows companies to manage vendor payments.
Settlement: The Commercial Credit Card bills are directly settled by the company. The company may make a consolidated payment for all cardholders.
How to use a Commercial Credit Card?
You can use and manage your HDFC Bank Commercial Credit Card through the Commercial Card Portal. This portal allows you to make credit limit adjustments, report lost or stolen cards, and generate PINs.

What is a Commercial Credit Card?
A Commercial Credit Card is a type of Credit Card specifically designed to manage business expenses. These cards are typically issued to corporate employees for business-related expenses. This eliminates the need to use personal funds to pay for business expenses and the hassle of the reimbursement process.
Who is eligible to apply for Commercial Credit Cards?
Corporates can apply for Commercial Credit Cards.
What is the credit limit of a Commercial Credit Card?
The credit limit of a Commercial Credit Card can vary based on the card variant and the overall financial standing of the business.
Is a Commercial Card the same as a Business Card?
Typically, small business owners are eligible for Business Credit Cards. Corporate Credit Cards are issued to owners and numerous employees of larger, well-established companies. Both these cards offer better business expense handling.
What are the fees and charges for a Commercial Credit Card?
The fees and charges for a particular Commercial Credit Card variant can be accessed via the card issuer’s website. Types of charges typically include late payment charges, cash advance charges, fuel surcharges, card re-issuance charges, etc. You can find the schedule of charges for HDFC Bank Commercial Credit Cards  here .
How to apply for a Commercial Credit Card?
The application process for a Commercial Credit Card involves submitting business proof and an adequate track record. The required documents must be submitted to the bank along with the application form duly signed by the relevant authorities in the company.

What is the Central Travel Account?
The Central Travel Account is perfect for managing and streamlining your corporate expenses that offers transparency and control over travel expenses, extended payment terms, enhanced travel data reports, and streamlined accounting procedures.
What are the benefits of Central Travel Account?
The Central Travel Account offers an array of benefits:
24x7 online access to customised MIS reports
Consolidated statement with enhanced data for visibility into travel expenses
Airline/hotel/merchant wise break up reports
Debit of net-fare charged by airline and cancellation refund on the card
Who are the target corporates for CTA?
Corporates looking for centralization of travel expenses management.
What is the minimum annual turnover required to apply for CTA?
10 Crores is the required Minimum annual turnover.
What if the turnover of the company is less than 10 Crores?
Company can still apply for CTA basis secured collaterals like Fixed deposit.
How are the bookings completed on CTA?
CTA is lodged with the travel agency of corporate. The employees of corporate will raise the Travel Requisition Form (TRF) to the travel agency. The travel agency will utilize the CTA card for each authorized travel requisition received.
Can the CTA card be used on Self Booking Tool (SBT)?
Yes, the corporate can use the CTA card on the SBT tool also.
What are the type of expenses which can be debited on CTA?
CTA card can be used for all Travel related expenses such as Air, Hotel & VISA bookings (Hotel & VISA expenses to be discussed in detail along with Travel agency)
What is the difference between Pass thru & Non Pass thru transactions?
Pass thru transactions – Airlines accepting the payment via credit card of the corporate are known as pass thru transactions. Such Airlines are normally present on GDS, however there are airlines who have their own portal to accept the card payments. For all pass thru transactions, the merchant name on statement appears as the Airline name.
Non pass thru transactions – Transactions where the airline ticket payment is done by the travel agent to airline and later charged to the corporate are called Non Pass-thru transaction. Normally LCC airlines works on Non-Pass-thru transactions. The bookings for these airlines is completed by debiting the CTA card on HDFC payment gateway issued to travel agencies, TMC name appears as the merchant for such transaction.
Is OTP required for CTA transactions?
OTP is not required for CTA transactions provided the bookings are completed by Travel agency on GDS or HDFC payment gateway.
How are the refunds handled on CTA?
All refunds for the cancelled bookings credited back to same CTA card
What is the process to dispute transactions which are not recognized by Corporate?
Transactions which aren’t recognized by the corporate has to be disputed before the due date with a valid dispute reason. Bank will provide temporary credit for the disputed amount & reach out to TMC / merchant for validation. In case response isn’t provided by TMC/merchant within 30-day bank will chargeback the merchant.
What are the various fields which can be captured on CTA?
CTA can capture following data:
L1: Financial data - Transaction amount, Transaction date, Merchant name, Card number, etc.
L2: Travel data - Ticket number, Routing, Invoice number, etc.
L3: Custom data - Employee id, cost center, project code etc.
What is the timeframe by which the dispute can be raised?
Corporate can raise the dispute within 60 days from the receipt of the Statement. However, in case disputes are raised post due date, any unpaid balances will attract finance / late fee charges.
What if the TMC charged the corporate twice on CTA card for same booking?
In such scenario, the TMC can provide the reversal of the transaction via Payment Gateway, credit note, etc. Or the corporate can raise a dispute for such transaction.
Can all travel agencies use CTA & provide enhanced data?
All Travel agencies who have GDS & Payment gateway facility can debit the corporate’s CTA card. However enhanced data can only be provided franchise certified travel agencies.
What is the process of certification of travel agencies?
Any Travel agency which needs to be certified for submission of enhanced data has to be introduced to franchisee networks – MasterCard, VISA, Diners via Products team.
Is it possible to push CTA transaction data to corporate ERP system?
Yes, transaction wise data can be pushed to corporate’s ERP system.
HDFC Bank is integrated with all major ERP systems such as Concur, Oracle, Happay, Zoho, please confirm the ERP system which corporate is using & raise the query to CTA Support desk.
Is there any cost to corporate for pushing data to ERP system?
No, there is no cost to corporate for pushing of data to ERP system. Though the corporate will have to bear the cost of integration with their ERP.
How is the reconciliation completed for CTA?
Corporate will be provided with a consolidated enhanced data report for all transactions debited on CTA card, reconciliation to be completed basis same (report can also be pulled from online reporting tools)
What are the payment options for CTA?
Payments can be made via cheque, auto debits or online modes such as NEFT, RTGS. Full payment needs to be made by the corporate to Bank (minus disputed transactions if any).
What is the servicing channel for CTA?
There is a dedicated CTA Support desk for handling CTA related queries, in addition requests can also be routed through Corporate Assist.
What are the Insurance covers provided on CTA?

What is a Corporate Premium Credit Card?
A Corporate Premium Credit Card is a payment card issued to a company for use by employees authorised to make travel-related expenses. This card is used for business-related expenses such as travel, supplies, dining, etc. Corporate Credit Card benefits both employees and the company. The company benefits from convenient expense management, streamlined cash flow and enhanced transparency. Employees can use this Credit Card to cover business expenses instead of paying from their personal account. The Credit Card bills are settled by the company itself.
Who can apply for a Corporate Premium Credit Card?
Companies can apply for a Corporate Premium Credit Card. Companies can then request the card issuer to issue individual Corporate Credit Cards to their employees.
Which entity types are eligible for corporate cards?
Private Limited, Public Limited and Partnership firms/LLP can apply for Corporate Credit Cards .
What is the limit of a Corporate Credit Card?
The credit limit of a Corporate Credit Card depends on various factors, including the company’s financial standing, creditworthiness and track record. You can get in touch with the bank to check your eligibility.
How can I apply for a Corporate Credit Card?
Click here to start your application for a Corporate Credit Card. The application process for a Commercial Credit Card involves submitting business proof and an adequate track record. The required documents must be submitted to the bank along with the application form duly signed by the relevant authorities in the company.
What is the minimum annual turnover required to apply for corporate cards?
Minimum annual turnover required to apply for corporate cards is ₹10 crore.
What if the turnover of the company is less than ₹10 crore?
Company can still apply for corporate cards basis secured collateral

Can a cardholder hold a corporate & individual HDFC Bank Credit Card (both at same time)?
Yes, cardholder can hold a corporate & individual card (consumer) under Sole, J&S & LLP programs.  However under declaration/ Individual liability program a cardholder can hold both the card only if corporate is eligible as part of dual carding policy (Dual card process rolled out separately)

What is Floater? How does it work?
Floater gives a flexibility to allocate credit limit at card level.

More about Commercial Credit Cards
Features of a Commercial Credit Card
HDFC Bank’s Commercial Credit Card offers a range of benefits, including up to 50 days of interest-free credit period, savings on business spends annually, and accelerated reward points on various business-related transactions. We also provide exclusive vouchers, complimentary lounge access, and a specially curated business insurance package tailored to your business needs.
Benefits of Commercial Credit Cards
Commercial Credit Cards offer a wide range of benefits:
Simplified and Streamlined Expense Management: Commercial Credit Cards simplify expense tracking by providing detailed statements that categorise spending. This makes it easier for companies to monitor and manage their finances.
Credit Limit Flexibility: Commercial Credit Cards may often come with higher credit limits than personal cards, providing businesses with greater purchasing power to cover various expenses.
Employee Spending Control: Commercial Cards may offer features like individual spending limits and real-time monitoring which allows businesses to control and track employee spending effectively.
Credit Card Rewards: Certain specific Commercial Credit Cards may also offer rewards programmes on business spendings, such as cashback or reward points for business-related purchases.
Travel Benefits: These cards may offer travel-related perks, including travel insurance, airport lounge access and reward points redemption against flights and accommodation. This can be beneficial for companies with frequent travel needs.
Streamlined Vendor Payments: Purchase Cards can be used to manage vendor payments, utility bills, fuel payments, bulk payments, etc.
How to Apply for a Commercial Credit Card?
To apply for HDFC Bank’s Commercial Credit Cards , you need to be self-employed individuals, proprietors of micro and small businesses, medium enterprises, traders, merchants, and professionals such as doctors, lawyers, chartered accountants, and consultants. If you fit these eligibility criteria, you can visit the HDFC Bank website, where you can choose your preferred Commerical Credit Card, fill out an application form, submit your KYC documents, and apply online.
How Do Commercial Credit Cards Work?
Here’s a brief on how Commercial Credit Cards work:
Issuance: Depending on the company’s eligibility, the card issuer will issue a Commercial Credit Card for the corporates. The company can then request the card issuer to issue cards to individual employees in their name.
Card Limits: Transaction limits can be set on the card to ensure the employees do not go overboard with spending. Depending on the employee’s designation in the company, the card limits can vary.
Usage: Commercial Credit Cards can be of two types, Corporate Credit Cards and Purchase Credit Cards. The former allows employees to pay for business expenses like travelling, meals, commuting, etc. A Purchase Credit Card allows companies to manage vendor payments.

Benefits of Commercial Credit Cards
Commercial Credit Cards offer a wide range of benefits:
Simplified and Streamlined Expense Management: Commercial Credit Cards simplify expense tracking by providing detailed statements that categorise spending. This makes it easier for companies to monitor and manage their finances.
Credit Limit Flexibility: Commercial Credit Cards may often come with higher credit limits than personal cards, providing businesses with greater purchasing power to cover various expenses.
Employee Spending Control: Commercial Cards may offer features like individual spending limits and real-time monitoring which allows businesses to control and track employee spending effectively.
Credit Card Rewards: Certain specific Commercial Credit Cards may also offer rewards programmes on business spendings, such as cashback or reward points for business-related purchases.
Travel Benefits: These cards may offer travel-related perks, including travel insurance, airport lounge access and reward points redemption against flights and accommodation. This can be beneficial for companies with frequent travel needs.
Streamlined Vendor Payments: Purchase Cards can be used to manage vendor payments, utility bills, fuel payments, bulk payments, etc.
How to Apply for a Commercial Credit Card?
To apply for HDFC Bank’s Commercial Credit Cards , you need to be self-employed individuals, proprietors of micro and small businesses, medium enterprises, traders, merchants, and professionals such as doctors, lawyers, chartered accountants, and consultants. If you fit these eligibility criteria, you can visit the HDFC Bank website, where you can choose your preferred Commerical Credit Card, fill out an application form, submit your KYC documents, and apply online.
How Do Commercial Credit Cards Work?
Here’s a brief on how Commercial Credit Cards work:
Issuance: Depending on the company’s eligibility, the card issuer will issue a Commercial Credit Card for the corporates. The company can then request the card issuer to issue cards to individual employees in their name.
Card Limits: Transaction limits can be set on the card to ensure the employees do not go overboard with spending. Depending on the employee’s designation in the company, the card limits can vary.
Usage: Commercial Credit Cards can be of two types, Corporate Credit Cards and Purchase Credit Cards. The former allows employees to pay for business expenses like travelling, meals, commuting, etc. A Purchase Credit Card allows companies to manage vendor payments.
Settlement: The Commercial Credit Card bills are directly settled by the company. The company may make a consolidated payment for all cardholders.
